predictions.articleTitle: Decoupling Ajax vs ADO Den Haag: Expected Goals (xG), Defensive Leaks & Match Intelligence

bet_recommendations.match_highlight: Ajax firepower meets Steijn's debut block amid home clean-sheet fragility.

spf.comment: Ajax's superior chance creation (2.22 xG/match) and returning creative depth should overcome ADO Den Haag's 2.01 xGA defense for a 2:1 or 3:1 victory.

score.comment: 2:1 is the 9.3% Poisson mode reflecting Steijn's initial resistance, with 3:1 (7.4%) capturing late home separation.

goals.comment: Three goals (21.0%) and four goals (19.3%) represent the two peak outcomes of the 3.67 lambda distribution.
